title: Minnesota Fraud Research Contradiction
description: Contradiction ledger. Do not silently choose the source we like. A source being official does not eliminate contradictions. Preserve source disagreement. Seed example: the Minnesota Judicial Branch stated on 2022-09-23 that Judge John Guthmann never ordered MDE to resume Feeding Our Future reimbursement payments; MDE resumed payments voluntarily. Any contrary public assertion is linked to that judicial correction rather than silently overwritten.

contradiction_id.description: Durable identifier. Never use a display name as a key.

source_a.description: Source of claim_a, if pinning the conflict to particular documents.

nature_of_conflict.description: What actually conflicts (dates, amounts, legal authority, actor identity, status, etc.).

possible_reconciliation.description: How the conflict might be resolved without picking a favorite source.

status.description: Whether the contradiction remains live. Unresolved contradictions should be exposable.

editorial_resolution.description: If resolved, the reasoned resolution with sources; never a silent overwrite.
